Tokens [page]: avg output tokens — average output tokens per task, overall and per suite (cost.csv: avg_input_tokens, avg_output_tokens, out_<suite>); output tokens shown in cost chart tooltip · https://livebench.ai/data/20261106/cost.csv

Breakdown [page]: Suite columns + Subcategories — 7 suite scores per model plus subcategory scores per suite (e.g. Long Agentic: Finance & Compliance Apps, Long-Run Operations, ...) · https://livebench.ai/data/20261106/breakdown.json
Other [page]: Open weights — open-weight flag (filter chip; openweight + Hugging Face link in model catalog) · https://livebench.ai/static/js/main.099aad9b.js
Other [page]: Organization / Finetune from / Base model — model organization column ('Show org') and finetune provenance · https://livebench.ai/static/js/main.099aad9b.js
Other [data]: Unmeasured tasks — nq_<suite> counts of measured tasks in cost/time files; unmeasured tasks score 0 · https://livebench.ai/data/20261106/llm_time.csv
Not reported: speed, uncertainty, runs, date, votes
Note: Site is JS-rendered; read via its data files and main JS bundle. Methodology states 'Single run: each suite is one run per model' (so no repeated-run data); only the release date ('Last updated') is shown, not a per-entry date. Cost/time/tokens are 2.0 (latest release) only.
